WriteTo.Name: Console
WriteTo._comment: TraceId is the same 32-hex id the error contract publishes as traceId. Without it in the template the console line carries no correlation at all, and a traceId off a support ticket cannot be grepped - it is only findable in the trace backend. Serilog reads it from Activity.Current, so it renders empty for anything logged outside a request, such as startup.

Tasks._comment: The generic async task queue over identity.task_queues (db/0014_task_queues.sql). WorkerCount=0 is the kill switch AND the shipped default: both hosted services read it at startup and return - nothing is polled, no timer runs, no connection is taken - and each says so in one log line, because "is this pod working the queue" has no endpoint to ask. It is also the switch that makes one image serve two deployment shapes (decision 02): API pods stay at 0, worker pods set a positive number. The other knobs - MaxAttempts, ShortPollInterval, LongPollInterval, StalePoppedTimeout, ReclaimInterval, TaskTimeout, DrainTimeout - all have working defaults on TaskQueueOptions and are deliberately not repeated here, so there is only one place for them to drift. Note that this service has no handler yet (the Go side's only one is the FCM topic sync, which belongs to the notification service), so raising WorkerCount today buys one log line saying no handler is registered.

_comment: Redis:Configuration and Notification:BaseAddress are deliberately absent. Both are [Required] and validated at startup, so a deployment without them refuses to boot instead of silently pointing at the wrong host. They arrive from Key Vault / ExternalSecrets as Redis__Configuration and Notification__BaseAddress. BackOfficeSignIn__SignInTicketKey belongs to the same set and is absent for the same reason, but is NOT validated at startup: a deployment without it boots and serves everything except the two back-office sign-in endpoints, which answer 500 NOT_CONFIGURED naming the key. Every replica must hold the SAME value - the ticket is minted by one pod and redeemed by another. StaffDirectory__* is optional in the same way and gates only the corporate one-time-password door.
